headline: ASOS hit by extortion hack via rogue push notifications
summary: Hackers sent unauthorized push notifications through ASOS's app claiming to have stolen customer data from its Snowflake environment; ASOS confirmed a breach, though theft of customer data remains unverified.

claims.statement: Hackers sent unauthorized 'HACKED' push notifications through the ASOS app claiming a Snowflake data compromise.

sources.quote: Dozens of people appear to have received a strange message from the clothing and beauty store's app.
ASOS confirms data breach after “HACKED” in-app notifications

claims.statement: ASOS confirmed a data breach after the rogue notifications, which claimed customer data was stolen from its Snowflake environment.

sources.quote: UK fashion retailer ASOS confirmed a data breach Tuesday after hackers sent unauthorized push notifications through its mobile app while claiming to have stolen customer data from the company's Snowflake environment.

claims.statement: Whether customer data was actually stolen remains unverified.

sources.quote: Rogue notification claims Snowflake instance compromised, but customer info theft remains unverified
